caption: The drawing consists of a single vertical rectangular panel outlined in a black border on an off-white background. Within the bordered panel, there is a central vertical arrangement of three stylized flowers with accompanying leaves. The top flower is blue with yellow stamens and surrounded by green leaves and yellow accents. The middle flower is pink with a yellow center and is flanked by small light blue leaves. The bottom flower is a more pronounced pink with smaller green leaves around it. Above the top flower are three small orange dots in a vertical line. The background inside the bordered panel is a light beige color, providing contrast for the pastel colors of the flowers and leaves.
title: Panel from Hall Lantern
